summary.text: Cody Huneycutt is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 67 in Montgomery and Stanly counties since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as cattle farming.

paragraphs.text: Cody Huneycutt holds an associate degree from Stanly Community College and a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, according to Ballotpedia.
He assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2025, succeeding Clayton Sasser (R).
The Republican primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
